precip.source: Mean annual precipitation, HadCM3L scotese_02 (Valdes et al. 2021)

temp.override_reason: The 65 Ma grid is an icehouse outlier (area mean 8.1 °C, −9 °C at 60°N) between warm 70 Ma (20.8 °C) and 60 Ma grids, although the dataset's own documentation lists 65–40 Ma as a hothouse interval; it appears to encode a K–Pg cooling event. Time Bubble models impact winter separately (Aftermath mode, DESIGN §8), so the base 65 Ma slice uses the 60 Ma (Palaeocene) grid instead.
temp.source: Mean annual surface temperature, scotese02a_v21321 (Scotese 2022; Scotese et al. 2021)
